May campaign: gem nodes subtype diffend-harvest in data/lanes/rubygems-goimport-campaign/events.jsonl (615 versions, triple-checked disk count), wave by earliest first_seen date (2026-05-11 rehearsal, 2026-05-12 burst); pin files add versions only (first_seen null for pin-only versions). node.status dead is mapped to yanked=true; the pins-diffend header states these were yanked from rubygems.org. go_import_target/VCS come from raw/gem-ioc-hits.jsonl fingerprints (go-import-repo, go-import-vcs, council-domain); gems with no IOC row carry payload_type null, not a guess. Builder detail for the three verified runner gems follows the Sept triple-check note. June-18 rows come from raw/gem-june18-wayback.jsonl pre-removal metadata (gems yanked, bytes unrecoverable); the 17th June name (16 Nightingale + 1 new) was not recovered from the files checked and is NOT included. July-7 JFrog specimens are report text, NOT locally captured bytes (their campaign gem bytes were found nowhere in our holdings); July-7-window Diffend gems are third-party test/researcher gems, explicitly NOT GemStuffer campaign gems. Probe-family rows carry their rescan triage verdicts. EXCLUDED: live legit contrast gems (json, oai, thor and the aws-sdk/gitlab/google-apis families, which appear only as contrast), the full 3,025-row JFrog GemStuffer CSV (third-party list; used only for jfrog_xray_id enrichment on overlapping names), and an unparsed ElasticSearch-style dump under docs/notes that may hold additional names but was not used as a curated source. No credential, key, token, or secret value is included anywhere in this file; author strings are registry metadata as recorded in lane files.
